name: media-paths-library-relative
body: Every media reference in a template or theme resolves inside the resolved library's `media/` tree. The layout `{{media "path"}}` helper takes a path relative to the resolved library's `media/`; a theme's `theme.css` (and any CSS it `@import`s from its own theme directory) reaches that same tree through the reserved `media:` URL prefix. In both forms the path is relative to `media/`, stays within it, and names an existing file; an absolute path, a path containing a `..` segment, or a path resolving outside the `media/` tree is a templates error qualified with the layout's or CSS file:line. `media` resolves only within the `media/` tree — never into a `themes/` directory — and within the library this preserves the self-contained/relocatable property (global.constraint.template-library-shareable).
